\chapter{Getting Started}
\label{ch:getting-started}

\guidechapterintro{This chapter takes you from the question of why Croqtile exists to a program you have built and run yourself. It begins with the motivation for the language and the properties it was designed around --- zero-cost abstractions, compile-time safety checks, dynamic shapes and symbolic dimensions, and a form that automated tuning can work with --- then follows a step-by-step path: the smallest kernel that compiles, progressively richer matmul variants, and the toolchain needed to build and inspect each one. By the end you will be able to reproduce the output of a simple program on your own.}
